Description: Research Resource Identifier (RRID) of the registered resource this specimen is, or was derived from, including the "RRID:" prefix. For cell lines, use the Cellosaurus RRID (e.g. RRID:CVCL_1H60): find it on the cell line's Cellosaurus page (https://www.cellosaurus.org/) under "Resource Identification Initiative: To cite this cell line use", or add "RRID:" to the Cellosaurus accession (CVCL_1H60 → RRID:CVCL_1H60). RRIDs from other registries are also accepted (e.g. RRID:IMSR_JAX:… for a JAX mouse strain). If more than one RRID applies, list them in the same order as researchResourceIDSource, so that the first RRID corresponds to the first source, the second to the second, and so on. Repeat it on every downstream specimen. If a derived line (e.g. an edited clone) has its own RRID, use that from that row on; otherwise keep the nearest registered ancestor's RRID.
